1. (Currently amended) A compound of formula (IIa) O NaO OR2 O (IIa), in which substituent R2 is selected from the group consisting of alkyl, aryl, and arylalkyl, __wherein the compound is prepared by a method comprising the step of reacting a 4-aminobut-2-enolide precursor with a sodium base__.

2. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (IIa) in which R2 is C1-C12-alkyl, C6-aryl, or arylalkyl, __wherein the sodium salt is formed in situ during the preparation method__.

3. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (IIa) in which R2 is methyl or ethyl, __wherein the compound exhibits enhanced stability compared to the corresponding potassium salt__.

4. (Currently amended) A compound of formula (IIb) O ZO OMe O O (IIb) in which substituent Z is selected from the group consisting of alkali metals and alkaline earth metals, __wherein Z is sodium and the compound is prepared by a method comprising the step of reacting a 4-aminobut-2-enolide precursor with a sodium base__.

5. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 4 of formula (IIb) in which Z is sodium, __wherein the sodium salt is formed as the primary product of the preparation method__.
